title: Analysis of Convergence for the IPA-AC Method
summary: The Improved Partial Area-Analytical Calculation (IPA-AC) method represents a leading meshfree discretization strategy for peridynamic models, distinguished by its rigorous geometric treatment of boundary intersections via dual corrections of integration weights and quadrature points. Despite its empirical success in suppressing boundary-induced geometric errors, a systematic theoretical characterization of its convergence behaviors under distinct scaling limits has remained elusive. This work establishes a unified convergence framework for the IPA-AC method applied to both scalar and tensor…
